i18n/plural#

Plural categories CLDR: which form of a word a number takes in a language.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

PluralCategoryOf(origin: PluralNumber("21"), locale: Locale("ru"), kind: PluralKind.cardinal).category();   // one
PluralCategoryOf(origin: PluralNumber("1.5"), locale: Locale("en"), kind: PluralKind.cardinal).category();  // other
PluralCategoryOf(origin: PluralNumber("2"), locale: Locale("en"), kind: PluralKind.ordinal).category();     // two (2nd)

Description#

Plural categories CLDR: which form of a word a number takes in a language.

A PluralNumber keeps its visible decimals: "1" and "1.0" differ, as CLDR says they do.

object PluralNumber#

object PluralNumber does PluralOperands

Preserve the spelling's visible fraction precision, unlike Decimal's numeric identity. Plain ASCII decimal only, no exponent/compact notation; 1024 scalars.
